quote.text: To the curious incident of the dog in the night-time.” “The dog did nothing in the night-time.” “That was the curious incident.
quote.author: Arthur Conan Doyle, “Silver Blaze”, The Strand Magazine, December 1892

stories.headline: No alert was issued. Thirteen died at the terminal
stories.dek: Saturday’s missile reached the passenger hall of King Khalid without any warning at all. On Sunday a second struck Terminal 4, and Dammam the same afternoon.

stories.headline: Eight points short of the first rung
stories.dek: The response ladder published on Friday begins at a PSI of 200. Central Singapore reached 192, and the Grand Prix ran at 154.

stories.headline: One pin binds first. That is the whole game
stories.dek: A lock opens to a pick because its chambers are imperfectly aligned. Find the order in which the pins bind and the plug turns — and then there are nine belts above you.

stories.headline: The glass will not stick to the rim
stories.dek: Enamel is glass fired onto steel at around 850°C. It cannot cover a rolled edge — which is where, in this climate, an heirloom begins to rust.

stories.headline: Six billion announced, three billion itemised
stories.dek: Eleven companies pledged $2.4bn in compute credits on Wednesday. Add every other component the day listed and you reach about half the headline.

stories.headline: The specification sheet is behind an email form
stories.dek: Technics will tell you the driver is filled with magnetic fluid. It will not tell you what the headphone weighs — and there is still no price for it here.

stories.headline: Seventy-seven pieces, built twice
stories.dek: Each box set is limited to 77 numbered examples. There are two box sets — so 154 platinum-gold watches exist under a 77-piece banner.

stories.headline: Eleven critics against two hundred and four
stories.dek: An 18 per cent horror film took $27.5m and beat an Aaron Sorkin picture five to one. The aggregate verdict on the winner rests on eleven reviews.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · The First Phone
stories.headline: The phone is the hinge, and the hinge is small
stories.dek: Among 3,486 children who had none at eleven, getting one by thirteen moved internalising problems by 0.11 of a standard deviation. Externalising did not move at all.

stories.kicker: The Big Picture · Higher For Longer
stories.headline: The Fed hinted again. Singapore’s banks took the blow
stories.dek: Hawkish minutes on Wednesday pinned the long end above 5 per cent. The damage landed six thousand miles away, in three stocks that are half the index.

stories.kicker: The Long Game · Protein And Muscle
stories.headline: Triple the protein, and the difference is nothing
stories.dek: In 108 women averaging 48, twelve weeks of identical training on 0.8, 1.6 or 2.2 grams per kilo produced no detectable difference in muscle mass. The p-value was 0.726.

stories.headline: Brazil plays twice in one Singapore week
stories.dek: A flash sale on the cheapest of those nights closes on the 19th. Fukuoka’s sumo sold out all fifteen days; Tokyo’s opens 5 December.

stories.headline: The word arrived three years after it was predicted
stories.dek: In 2023 a Chinese user wrote that the day of human feed might not be far off. By this summer office workers were freezing a week of dinners in trays and calling it exactly that.
